items.title: Added path parameter to the EnterWorktree tool to switch into an existing worktree of the current repository

explanation.what_it_is: The EnterWorktree tool in Claude Code now accepts a path parameter, allowing users to switch into an existing worktree of the current repository.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables users to easily switch between different worktrees in their repository, streamlining their workflow and reducing the need to manually navigate between worktrees.
how_to_use: Use the EnterWorktree tool with the path parameter to switch to an existing worktree, e.g., 'EnterWorktree /path/to/existing/worktree'
Switch between worktrees to work on different features or branches without having to clone the repository multiple times

items.title: Added PreCompact hook support: hooks can now block compaction by exiting with code 2 or returning {"decision":"block"}

explanation.what_it_is: The PreCompact hook support allows hooks to block compaction by exiting with a specific code or returning a decision to block. This is done by exiting with code 2 or returning {"decision":"block"}.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update gives Claude Code users more control over the compaction process, allowing them to prevent compaction from occurring under certain conditions. This can be useful for ensuring data integrity or preventing unintended changes.
how_to_use: Exit a hook with code 2 to block compaction
Return {"decision":"block"} from a hook to prevent compaction

items.title: Added background monitor support for plugins via a top-level monitors manifest key that auto-arms at session start or on skill invoke

explanation.what_it_is: Background monitor support for plugins is now available via a top-level monitors manifest key, allowing plugins to run in the background and monitor events.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to create plugins that can run continuously in the background, monitoring events and taking actions without requiring manual intervention, which can streamline workflows and improve automation.
how_to_use: Add a monitors key to your plugin's manifest to specify the events to monitor
Use the auto-arming feature to start monitoring at session start or when a skill is invoked

items.title: Added /team-onboarding command to generate a teammate ramp-up guide from your local Claude Code usage

explanation.what_it_is: The /team-onboarding command generates a guide to help new teammates get up to speed with your local Claude Code usage.
explanation.why_it_matters: This command saves time and effort when onboarding new team members by automatically creating a personalized ramp-up guide based on your existing Claude Code setup.
how_to_use: Run the /team-onboarding command in your Claude Code environment to generate a teammate ramp-up guide.
Use the generated guide to walk new teammates through your local Claude Code usage and best practices.

items.title: Added OS CA certificate store trust by default, so enterprise TLS proxies work without extra setup (set CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE=bundled to use only…

explanation.what_it_is: Claude Code now trusts the OS CA certificate store by default, allowing TLS proxies to work without additional configuration.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change simplifies the setup process for enterprise users who rely on TLS proxies, as they no longer need to manually configure certificate trust.
how_to_use: Run Claude Code without extra setup to use the OS CA certificate store trust
Set CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE=bundled to revert to using only the bundled certificate store

items.title: Added interactive Google Vertex AI setup wizard accessible from the login screen when selecting "3rd-party platform", guiding you through GCP…

explanation.what_it_is: An interactive setup wizard for Google Vertex AI, accessible from the login screen when selecting '3rd-party platform', which guides users through the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) setup process.
explanation.why_it_matters: This wizard simplifies the process of setting up Google Vertex AI with Claude Code, reducing the complexity and potential errors associated with manual configuration.
how_to_use: Select '3rd-party platform' on the login screen to access the wizard
Follow the wizard's prompts to configure your GCP setup for Google Vertex AI

items.title: Added CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE env var: when set, Edit/Write/NotebookEdit fail on read-only files with a p4 edit hint instead of silently…

explanation.what_it_is: The CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE environment variable, when set, changes the behavior of Edit, Write, and NotebookEdit operations on read-only files with a Perforce edit hint.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change prevents silent overwrites of read-only files, instead failing the operation and alerting the user to the need for a Perforce edit.
how_to_use: Set CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE to enable explicit edit checks for read-only files
Use this variable in Perforce-managed projects to avoid accidental overwrites

items.title: Added Monitor tool for streaming events from background scripts

explanation.what_it_is: The Monitor tool is a feature that allows users to stream events from background scripts, providing real-time visibility into script activity.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to debug and monitor their background scripts more effectively, allowing for faster issue identification and resolution.
how_to_use: Use the Monitor tool to stream events from background scripts and identify performance bottlenecks
Monitor script activity in real-time to quickly detect and respond to errors

items.title: Added subprocess sandboxing with PID namespace isolation on Linux when CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB is set, and CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS env var…

explanation.what_it_is: Subprocess sandboxing with PID namespace isolation on Linux, enabled when CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB and CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS environment variables are set.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enhances security by isolating subprocesses from the main process, reducing the risk of privilege escalation attacks on Linux systems.
how_to_use: Set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB and CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS environment variables to enable subprocess sandboxing
Run Claude Code on Linux with the enabled environment variables to utilize PID namespace isolation

items.title: Added --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections flag to print mode for improved cross-user prompt caching

explanation.what_it_is: The --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections flag is a new option in Claude Code's print mode that allows users to exclude dynamic system prompt sections from the output.
explanation.why_it_matters: This flag improves cross-user prompt caching by preventing dynamic sections from interfering with the caching process, resulting in more efficient caching across different users.
how_to_use: Use the --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections flag in print mode to exclude dynamic system prompt sections from the output, like this: `claude print --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections`

items.title: Added workspace.git_worktree to the status line JSON input, set whenever the current directory is inside a linked git worktree

explanation.what_it_is: The workspace.git_worktree property is now included in the status line JSON input when the current directory is part of a linked Git worktree.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows Claude Code users to programmatically detect and respond to the presence of a linked Git worktree, enabling more customized workflows and automation.
how_to_use: Check the workspace.git_worktree property in your status line JSON input to determine if the current directory is inside a linked Git worktree
Use this property to trigger custom scripts or actions when working within a linked worktree

items.title: Added W3C TRACEPARENT env var to Bash tool subprocesses when OTEL tracing is enabled, so child-process spans correctly parent to Claude Code's trace…

explanation.what_it_is: The W3C TRACEPARENT environment variable is now added to Bash tool subprocesses when OpenTelemetry (OTEL) tracing is enabled, allowing child-process spans to be correctly linked to Claude Code's trace.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update ensures that tracing information is accurately propagated to child processes, providing a more complete view of the execution flow in Claude Code.
how_to_use: Enable OTEL tracing in your Claude Code project to automatically include the W3C TRACEPARENT env var in Bash tool subprocesses
Verify that child-process spans are correctly parented to Claude Code's trace in your tracing output

items.title: We've launched the advisor tool in public beta
items.summary: We've launched the advisor tool in public beta. Pair a faster executor model with a higher-intelligence advisor model that provides strategic guidance mid-generation, so long-horizon agentic…

explanation.what_it_is: The advisor tool is a feature that pairs a faster executor model with a higher-intelligence advisor model, providing strategic guidance mid-generation for long-horizon tasks.
explanation.why_it_matters: This tool allows Claude Code users to generate more coherent and effective outputs, especially for tasks that require planning and strategic decision-making.
how_to_use: Use the advisor tool to guide the generation of complex, multi-step plans
Pair the advisor tool with a faster executor model to accelerate task completion while maintaining strategic oversight

items.title: Added focus view toggle (Ctrl+O) in NO_FLICKER mode showing prompt, one-line tool summary with edit diffstats, and final response

explanation.what_it_is: A focus view toggle feature, accessible via Ctrl+O, that displays the prompt, a one-line tool summary with edit diffstats, and the final response in NO_FLICKER mode.
explanation.why_it_matters: This feature allows Claude Code users to quickly toggle between views, reducing visual distractions and making it easier to focus on specific parts of the code and response.
how_to_use: Press Ctrl+O to toggle the focus view on and off in NO_FLICKER mode
Use the focus view to quickly review edit diffstats and the final response

items.title: Added refreshInterval status line setting to re-run the status line command every N seconds

explanation.what_it_is: The refreshInterval setting allows you to configure the status line to re-run its command at a specified interval, measured in seconds.
explanation.why_it_matters: This setting enables dynamic updates to the status line, allowing for real-time information and reducing the need for manual refreshes.
how_to_use: Set refreshInterval to 5 to update the status line every 5 seconds
Use refreshInterval to periodically re-run a command that fetches external data

items.title: Added workspace.git_worktree to the status line JSON input, set when the current directory is inside a linked git worktree

explanation.what_it_is: The workspace.git_worktree property is now included in the status line JSON input when the current directory is part of a linked Git worktree.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows Claude Code users to programmatically detect when they are working within a linked Git worktree, enabling more precise automation and scripting.
how_to_use: Check the status line JSON input for the workspace.git_worktree property to determine if the current directory is inside a linked Git worktree.
Use this property to trigger custom scripts or actions when working within a linked worktree.

items.title: Added ● N running indicator in /agents next to agent types with live subagent instances

explanation.what_it_is: A running indicator, denoted by ● N, is now displayed next to agent types in the /agents section when there are live subagent instances.
explanation.why_it_matters: This indicator provides a visual cue for Claude Code users to quickly identify which agent types have active subagents, making it easier to monitor and manage their agents.
how_to_use: Check the /agents section to see which agent types have live subagent instances indicated by ● N
Use this indicator to quickly identify and investigate agents with active subagents

items.title: Added syntax highlighting for Cedar policy files (.cedar, .cedarpolicy)

explanation.what_it_is: Syntax highlighting for Cedar policy files (.cedar, .cedarpolicy) is now supported in Claude Code, making it easier to read and understand policy file contents.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update simplifies the process of writing and editing Cedar policy files by providing visual cues for syntax, reducing errors and improving overall workflow efficiency.
how_to_use: Open a .cedar or .cedarpolicy file in Claude Code to see syntax highlighting in action
Use the highlighting to quickly identify policy file structure and syntax

items.title: We've launched Claude Managed Agents in public beta, a fully managed agent…
items.summary: We've launched Claude Managed Agents in public beta, a fully managed agent harness for running Claude as an autonomous agent with secure sandboxing, built-in tools, and server-sent event streaming.…

explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to deploy and manage autonomous agents more easily, with built-in security and tooling features.
how_to_use: Use Claude Managed Agents to deploy autonomous agents with secure sandboxing
Leverage built-in tools for agent management and monitoring
Utilize server-sent event streaming for real-time agent updates

items.title: We've launched the ant CLI, a command-line client for the Claude API that…
items.summary: We've launched the ant CLI, a command-line client for the Claude API that enables faster interaction with the Claude API, native integration with Claude Code, and versioning of API resources in YAML…

explanation.what_it_is: The ant CLI is a command-line client for the Claude API, allowing users to interact with the API more efficiently and integrate it with Claude Code.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables faster development and testing workflows by providing a native way to manage API resources and version them in YAML.
how_to_use: Use the ant CLI to create and manage Claude API resources from the command line
Integrate the ant CLI with Claude Code to streamline your development workflow
Version your API resources in YAML for easier tracking and management

items.title: Added support for Amazon Bedrock powered by Mantle, set CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1

explanation.what_it_is: Claude Code now supports Amazon Bedrock powered by Mantle, which can be enabled by setting the CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE environment variable to 1.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows Claude Code users to leverage the capabilities of Amazon Bedrock and Mantle, potentially expanding their deployment options.
how_to_use: Set CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1 to enable Mantle support
Use Claude Code with Amazon Bedrock to deploy models

items.title: Added compact Slacked #channel header with a clickable channel link for Slack MCP send-message tool calls

explanation.what_it_is: A compact header with a clickable link to the Slack channel has been added to the send-message tool calls in the Slack MCP tool in Claude Code.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update makes it easier for users to quickly navigate to the relevant Slack channel when sending messages, streamlining their workflow.
how_to_use: Use the send-message tool in the Slack MCP tool to send a message to a Slack channel and click on the channel link in the compact header to navigate to the channel.
Click on the channel link in the compact header to open the Slack channel in your browser or Slack app.

items.title: Added keep-coding-instructions frontmatter field support for plugin output styles

explanation.what_it_is: The keep-coding-instructions frontmatter field is now supported for plugin output styles, allowing users to preserve coding instructions in their output.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to maintain coding instructions in their plugin output, making it easier to review and understand the generated code.
how_to_use: Add a keep-coding-instructions field to your frontmatter to preserve coding instructions in plugin output
Use this feature to maintain documentation and comments in your generated code

items.title: Added hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle to UserPromptSubmit hooks for setting the session title

explanation.what_it_is: The hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle is a new property added to UserPromptSubmit hooks, allowing you to set the title of a session. This property enables more fine-grained control over session metadata.
explanation.why_it_matters: With this update, Claude Code users can now programmatically set the session title when submitting a user prompt, making it easier to organize and track sessions. This change simplifies workflow management and session tracking.
how_to_use: Use hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle to set a descriptive title for a session when submitting a user prompt, such as 'Initial User Input' or 'Follow-up Question'.
Update existing UserPromptSubmit hooks to include the sessionTitle property for better session organization.

items.title: [VSCode] Added a warning banner when settings.json files fail to parse, so users know their permission rules are not being applied

explanation.what_it_is: A warning banner in VSCode that appears when a settings.json file fails to parse, indicating that permission rules are not being applied.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change helps users identify and fix issues with their settings.json files, ensuring that their intended permission rules are actually in effect.
how_to_use: Check the warning banner in VSCode to see if your settings.json file has parsing errors
Fix any syntax errors in your settings.json file to ensure permission rules are applied correctly

items.title: Added forceRemoteSettingsRefresh policy setting: when set, the CLI blocks startup until remote managed settings are freshly fetched, and exits if the…

explanation.what_it_is: The forceRemoteSettingsRefresh policy setting is a new option that, when enabled, forces the CLI to wait for fresh remote managed settings before starting up.
explanation.why_it_matters: This setting ensures that the CLI always uses the latest remote managed settings, which can be particularly important in environments where settings are frequently updated.
how_to_use: Set forceRemoteSettingsRefresh to true in your policy settings to enable the feature
Use this setting in environments where remote managed settings are frequently updated, such as in large-scale deployments

items.title: Added interactive Bedrock setup wizard accessible from the login screen when selecting "3rd-party platform" — guides you through AWS authentication,…

explanation.what_it_is: An interactive Bedrock setup wizard that guides users through AWS authentication when selecting a 3rd-party platform from the login screen.
explanation.why_it_matters: This wizard simplifies the process of setting up Bedrock with AWS, reducing the complexity and potential errors associated with manual configuration.
how_to_use: Select '3rd-party platform' from the login screen to access the wizard
Follow the wizard's prompts to authenticate with AWS and complete the Bedrock setup

items.title: Added per-model and cache-hit breakdown to /cost for subscription users

explanation.what_it_is: The /cost endpoint now provides a breakdown of costs by model and cache hits for subscription users, giving more detailed insights into cost distribution.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change allows subscription users to better understand and optimize their costs by identifying which models are driving expenses and how cache hits are impacting their bills.
how_to_use: Use the /cost endpoint to retrieve a detailed breakdown of your costs, including per-model and cache-hit metrics.
Analyze the breakdown to identify areas where you can optimize model usage and cache hits to reduce costs.

items.title: Added MCP tool result persistence override via _meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"] annotation (up to 500K), allowing larger results like DB schemas…

explanation.what_it_is: The MCP tool now allows result persistence override via a _meta annotation, enabling larger results of up to 500K characters. This is achieved by setting _meta['anthropic/maxResultSizeChars'] to the desired size.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update matters because it allows Claude Code users to work with larger results, such as database schemas, that previously exceeded the character limit. This change enables more complex workflows and larger data processing tasks.
how_to_use: Set _meta['anthropic/maxResultSizeChars'] to 500000 to allow for larger results like DB schemas
Use the annotation to override the default result size limit in MCP tool outputs

items.title: Added disableSkillShellExecution setting to disable inline shell execution in skills, custom slash commands, and plugin commands

explanation.what_it_is: The disableSkillShellExecution setting allows you to disable inline shell execution in skills, custom slash commands, and plugin commands within Claude Code.
explanation.why_it_matters: This setting gives Claude Code users more control over security and execution permissions, allowing them to restrict potentially risky shell execution in specific contexts.
how_to_use: Set disableSkillShellExecution to true in your configuration to prevent skills and custom commands from executing shell commands inline.
Use this setting to enforce security policies in environments where shell execution poses a risk.

items.title: Added support for multi-line prompts in claude-cli://open?q= deep links (encoded newlines %0A no longer rejected)

explanation.what_it_is: The ability to use multi-line prompts in claude-cli://open?q= deep links by encoding newlines as %0A, which are no longer rejected.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows Claude Code users to create more complex and formatted prompts when opening links, enabling more precise and detailed queries.
how_to_use: Use %0A to encode newlines in your prompts, such as 'prompt line 1%0Aprompt line 2'
Create multi-line prompts in claude-cli://open?q= deep links to test and refine your queries
